results.title: Da gaske duniya za ta tashi ranar Juma'a 13 ga watan Nuwamba?

results.title: Ƴan Najeriya 5 da suka samu kujeru a majalisar dokokin Amurka
results.content: Sakamakon zaɓen ya nuna cewa jam'iyyar Democrat ta samu kujeru fiye da jam'iyyar Republican, wadda Shugaba Donald Trump yake wakilta. A yayin zaɓen, an samu wasu abubuwa da ba a yi tsammani ba, ciki har da nasarar 'yan Najeriya da sauran Baƙaƙen fata da suka samu kujeru a majalisun dokokin Amurka.

results.title: Laika: Karen da ya riga bil'adama zuwa sararin samaniya
results.content: A watan Nuwamban shekarar 1957, masana kimiyya a Tarayyar Soviet sun aika wata karya mai suna Laika zuwa sararin samaniya da ake ganin ba za a iya dawo da ita ba, lamarin da ya mayar da ita jarumar ƙasa, amma makomarta ta kasance mai ban tausayi.

results.title: Yadda za ku yi amfani da wayarku wajen neman rancen kuɗi daga Gwamnatin Najeriya
results.content: Gwamnatin Tarayya ta ƙaddamar da wani shiri da zai bai wa 'yan Najeriya damar tara kuɗi domin sayen muhimman kayayyaki kamar abinci da biyan wutar lantarki da sauran ƙananan buƙatu ta hanyar wayoyinsu.

results.title: Hanyoyi biyar da za a gane yara sun fara mu'amala da masu tsattsauran ra'ayi
results.content: A cewarsa, idan matashi yana ganin yana da makoma, yana samun kulawa daga iyaye kuma yana da abin yi mai amfani, zai fi wuya ya faɗa tarkon masu tsauraran ra'ayi.

results.title: Me ya sa wasu ke ganin fatalwa?
results.content: Tun daga tsoffin tatsuniyoyin al'ummar Mesofotamiya da ke ba da labarin fatalwowi da ke buƙatar kulawa daga danginsu da suka rage a raye, har zuwa littafin Charles Dickens mai suna A Christmas Carol, ɗan'adam yana da dogon tarihi na bayar da labaran fatalwowi.

results.title: Sauke manhaja

results.title: Najeriya ta lashe kofin duniya na mata

results.title: Liverpool na zawarcin Verbruggen, Bayern Munich na harin Ngumoha
results.content: Liverpool na zawrcin mai tsaron ragar Brighton Bart Verbruggen, sai Bayern Munich da ke tattaunawa da ɗan wasan Liverpool Rio Ngumoha camp yayin da ƙungiyoyin da ke nuga gasar Firimiya ke bibiyar ɗan wasan Tottenham Conor Gallagher.

results.title: Fa'az: Sabon makami mai linzami na zamani da Pakistan ta ƙera
results.content: A baya-bayan nan, Pakistan ta yi nasarar gwajin wani makamin linzami mai suna Fa'az, wanda sojojin ƙasar suka bayyana a matsayin na farko irinsa da aka ƙera a cikin gida.

results.title: Waɗanne abubuwa ne a cikin ɗakin Ka'abah?

results.title: Su wane ne za su ci gajiyar tallafin N50,000 na gwamnatin Najeriya?
results.content: Ministan harkokin jin ƙai Bernard Doro ya bayyana cewa masu amfana ba sa buƙatar neman shiga shirin, biyan wani kuɗi, ko yin rajista ta hannun wasu wakilai domin samun damar cin gajiyar shirin.

results.title: Me sakamakon zaɓen Amurka ke nufi ga ƙasashen duniya?
results.content: Jam'iyyar Democrat ta karɓe ikon majalisar dokokin Amurka, inda za ta ci gaba da tafiyar da majalisar har zuwa ƙarshen wa'adin shugabancin Donald Trump. Sakamakon zaɓen tsakiyar wa'adin ya kawo babban sauyi a fagen siyasar Amurka. BBC ta yi bayani kan abin da sakamakon zaɓen ke nufi ga sauran ƙasashen duniya, tun daga yaƙe-yaƙen Ukraine da na Gabas ta Tsakiya zuwa dangantakar kasuwanci tsakanin Amurka da China.

results.title: Lokutan da Shugaba Tinubu ya nemi rancen ƙasashen waje
results.content: Shugaban Najeriya Bola Ahmed Tinubu ya aike da buƙata a hukumance zuwa Majalisar dokoki domin neman amincewa ya karɓo rance daga ƙasashen waje da ya kai dala biliyan 7.7, kwatankwacin naira triliyan 10.79 don taimakawa wajen cike giɓin kasafin kuɗin 2026 na naira triliyan 31.4.

results.title: Matasa 'yan Afirka da suka lashe zaɓen Amurka
results.content: A lokacin yaƙin neman zaɓensa, El-Sayed ya yi amfani da kafafen sada zumunta sosai wajen isa ga masu zaɓe, musamman matasa. A bidiyoyinsa da yake wallafawa a dandalin TikTok, ana ganinsa yana magana kai tsaye da matasan Gen Z, inda yake amfani da barkwanci da matasan ke so, har ma da sanya mundayen abota a hannunsa.
